annotations.title: Etsy listing position for a search (paused: Etsy's API unavailable)

description: PAUSED: Growtsy can't read Etsy's API right now (since 19 November 2026); this tool returns the error etsy_offline — don't retry it. Instead: etsy_seller_answer ("How do I check where my Etsy listing ranks?"), and etsy_listing_text_check for the words in the title and tags. When Etsy access returns: Position of a listing (or a shop's listings) in the first 100 active listings Etsy's API returns for a search phrase, in relevance order, and which words of the phrase are missing from its title and tags. Beyond 100 it says 'not in the first 100'. etsy.com search can differ per shopper.
